_doc: Engine Capability Map. Each capability is [id, name, owner-skill, maturity, contributors?]. Maturity: E=established production, M=emerging production, X=experimental research, S=speculative. Exactly one owner per capability; contributors must coordinate through the owner's contract.

areas.name: Requirements & configuration profiles
caps: Capture target game requirements (genre, scale, platforms, online model) as engine requirements
Engine configuration profiles & feature sets (indie 2D → AAA open-world online)
Hardware tier definitions incl. server instance classes and refresh-rate classes
Supported-target matrix (OS × ISA × GPU API × store × support tier)

areas.name: Structure & boundaries
caps: Subsystem replaceability & optionality (modules absent in small profiles)
Global conventions: units, handedness, up-axis, coordinate spaces
Cross-domain arbitration & escalation of boundary disputes
Registered platform backend slots (RHI, IO, audio endpoint, input, sockets, crash, save storage, service SDK, IME/a11y bridge)
Declarative self-registration for phases, render features, services, cvars, codegen inputs (no central tables)
Contract binding policy: implementation chosen at compile/link/load time; batch-granular interfaces; no per-item virtual dispatch across contracts on hot paths

areas.name: Architecture governance
caps: ADR lifecycle with evidence, alternatives, revisit conditions
Automated architectural fitness functions (layering, dependency, contract conformance)
Anti-legacy review against the flagged-pattern catalogue (data/legacy-patterns.json)
Technology radar (data/radar.json): maturity, owners, revisit triggers, non-goals
Governance weight per organization tier (which ADR/CR/critic stages are mandatory)

areas.name: Research & evidence
caps: Prototype/spike protocol producing evidence where literature is thin

areas.name: Agent organization
caps: Milestone → task decomposition by skill territory
Milestone ladder with per-milestone skill set, contract maturity & exit criteria (data/milestones.json)
Agent staffing tiers: co-hosting of skills per organization scale (by workstream)
Escalation tiers & decision SLAs; delegated arbitration inside a lead's subtree
Register of decisions requiring human authorization (contracts, spend, NDA access, submissions, legal sign-off)
Program risk register & risk-driven milestone ordering
Failure attribution, bisection, routing to owners, revert-first policy
Critic calibration via seeded defects; rounds count only above recall threshold
Independent adjudication of rejected and partially accepted findings
Per-change agent/model/task attestation in the ledger

areas.name: Engine product management
caps: Game-team bug & feature intake and triage SLAs
Customer/reference project corpus validating each release
Engine licensing & terms model for game teams

areas.name: Platform abstraction layer
caps: OS services abstraction (VM, files, time, dynamic libraries)
CPU topology & feature discovery (hybrid cores, SMT, caches, NUMA, ISA)
Bootstrap base (C-BASE): raw allocator, raw sinks, hook tables
Thread creation, affinity & QoS per OS
Thread-affinity registry & isolation of OS-thread-bound APIs behind queues; engine loop never assumes the OS main thread
Processes, pipes, shared memory, local/dev sockets, HTTP(S)/TLS client (platform stacks)
System events & queries: memory pressure, reachability, audio endpoints, locale, OS accessibility settings, overlay/focus, storage, page size
Device capability database: hardware → tier mapping, deny-lists, remote updates
Supported OS versions, deprecation & beta-OS validation
NDA platform extensions: segregated modules/repos, public stubs, sanitized CI results, access classes
Display enumeration, modes, DPI, HDR & VRR capability

areas.name: Desktop & handheld PC
caps: OS security interplay (Defender scanning, controlled folders, notarization, TCC, sandboxes, anti-cheat on Proton)
Windows on ARM (ARM64EC, emulation interop, middleware availability)

areas.name: Console-class platforms
caps: Console OS & memory model (UMA, reserved memory, fixed hardware)
Console graphics API backends (confidential extensions implementing C-RHI)

areas.name: Mobile & portable
caps: Runtime storage constraints (free-space checks, OS cache purge)

areas.name: Platform & online services integration
caps: User identity, sign-in, account linking, crossplay identity
Privileges & parental controls at feature boundaries
Age verification, playtime/spending limits & regional policy enforcement
Voice & text chat sessions, channels, mute/block enforcement
Remote generative-AI/inference boundary (auth, quotas, cost, latency, routing)

areas.name: XR
caps: Scene understanding (planes, meshes, semantic labels, environment depth)

areas.name: Web platform
caps: WASM threads, cross-origin isolation & memory limits

areas.name: Commerce & monetization boundary
caps: Consumable, non-consumable & subscription purchases via first-party stores
Randomized-item odds disclosure & regional spending rules
Ad-SDK integration boundary (consent, mediation, rewarded callbacks, isolation)

areas.name: Lifecycle, modules, configuration, errors
caps: Parallel boot via init dependency graph
Service registry & dependency-injection policy (no hidden globals)
Layered configuration, cvars, command line, per-platform/device and remote layers with precedence
Error-handling & failure model (expected-style results, fatal vs recoverable)
Assertion tiers & contract checks (C++26 contracts as adoption path)
Implementation language(s), standard baseline & compiler feature policy (incl. C++26 adoption plan, coding standard)
Serial bootstrap phase until the scheduler is live; hand-off to parallel init
Engine-wide ownership, cross-thread reference rules & retirement service
Engine IPC/RPC transport & process model for tools, workers, crash handler, profiler
Config reads via immutable snapshots latched at sync points; queued change notification
Multi-language interop & memory-safe components (FFI/ABI rules, ownership across boundaries)

areas.name: Math & numerics
caps: Double & mixed-precision math for large worlds
Wide-SIMD / SPMD kernels for fixed and scalable (VLA) vector ISAs, runtime ISA dispatch

areas.name: Memory
caps: Allocator families (linear/frame, pool, TLSF, slab, buddy)
Memory debugging (guard pages, poisoning, sanitizer integration)

areas.name: Core types & containers
caps: Containers (arrays, open-addressing hash maps, inline, SoA, intrusive, rings)
Non-cryptographic & stable content hashing with versioned algorithm/seed guarantees
General-purpose compression codec library for non-package users
Vetted cryptographic primitives wrapper, CSPRNG, per-platform selection

areas.name: Concurrency primitives
caps: Synchronization primitives (futex-backed locks, events, spin with backoff)
Lock-free / wait-free structures (MPMC queues, work-stealing deques)

areas.name: Jobs, task graphs, fibers
caps: Fibers & language coroutines (fiber-safe TLS, debugger/profiler/sanitizer annotations)
IO & GPU completion integration into the scheduler
Engine thread inventory, core reservation, OS priority/QoS mapping, real-time thread rules, middleware pool adapters, oversubscription detection
Serial/deterministic execution mode & seeded schedule perturbation hooks
Task tracing, critical-path & utilization analysis, OS scheduler correlation
Dependency-race detection for declared task dependencies

areas.name: Frame & time orchestration
caps: Frame pipelining & frames in flight (incl. whether any dedicated render/RHI thread exists, by ADR)
Tick phases, sync points & phase barriers
Time domains (real, game, dilation, pause) & clocks
Input-to-photon latency & frame pacing (Reflex / Anti-Lag class)
Unified access declarations for all phase work (ECS and service resources) with derived ordering
Canonical simulation phase order (pre/post-physics, substeps, net snapshot, render extract)
Time-sliced / rate-bucketed ticking & per-phase tick budgets
Detection of writes to data owned by another phase
Present timeline, pacing feedback & interposed presenters (C-PRESENT)

areas.name: Object model & identity
caps: Hybrid object-model policy (ECS vs services vs asset objects vs UI objects)
Reference kinds & explicit lifetime (owner + generational handles; no tracing GC over engine objects; script references are weak handles)
Events & messaging: deferred, batched delivery at declared consumption points by default

areas.name: Entity component system
caps: Component storage (archetype chunks vs sparse sets)
Lowering ECS systems into the frame access model
ECS ↔ subsystem bulk-sync adapters (physics, animation, audio, render, transforms)
World/component snapshot & restore, rollback-able component marking
Debug declared-vs-actual access checking & system-order ambiguity detection

areas.name: Reflection & metadata
caps: Reflection generation (codegen now; C++26 static reflection when available)
Static/compile-time reflection & resolved IDs on runtime paths; string lookup only at tool, script and serialization boundaries

areas.name: Runtime scalability
caps: Actuator registration (dynres, significance, VFX, animation rate, workers)

areas.name: Runtime resource management
caps: Cross-pool memory & IO-bandwidth arbitration (textures, geometry pages, shadow pages, audio, animation, world cells, BVH, model weights); single physical budget on UMA; OS pressure signals
Batched GPU-originated streaming requests (feedback buffers) & latency contract
Staged load pipeline, per-stage queues, staging-memory budget, batching, cancellation

areas.name: Asynchronous IO
caps: Async IO backends (io_uring, IOCP, DirectStorage, console APIs)
IO scheduling, prioritization, queue depth, batching
Memory-mapped IO restricted to prefetched/locked or tool-side use
CPU decompression as an IO stage
HTTP/CDN IO backend with persistent content cache, prefetch & offline policy

areas.name: Packages & virtual file system
caps: VFS mounting & layering (base, patch, DLC, mods)

areas.name: Asset identity & registry
caps: Asset rights/license/provenance metadata through cook to a shipping rights manifest

areas.name: Import & interchange
caps: Texture source formats (EXR, PNG, TIFF, PSD)

areas.name: Cooking & derived data
caps: Cook-step processor contract (inputs, cache keys, determinism)
Texture processing & GPU texture-compression encoding (BCn, ASTC)
World-scoped derived-data build graph: region invalidation, distributed bakes, staleness reporting
On-demand cooking, cook-server streaming to running targets, play without full cook
GPU & training cook steps with pinned-artifact determinism & dataset lineage
Image processing (mips, normal maps, channel packing)
Mesh boolean, remesh & UV-unwrap operations for processors and blockout
ML-assisted retopology/UV/LOD techniques as processor options

areas.name: Content validation
caps: Content budget validation (triangles, texture sizes, bones)
Asset reference, size & chunk auditing tools
Validate-on-save & pre-submit content checks (domain validators registered via hooks)

areas.name: World model
caps: World representation strategy (data-oriented, no universal scene graph)

areas.name: Partitioning & streaming
caps: Budgeted, time-sliced cell activation with bulk registration
Off-bubble simulation tiers (abstract/statistical sim, promotion/demotion, remote server regions)

areas.name: Transforms & spatial queries
caps: Generic spatial index & query service for non-physics consumers
Spatial hashing for massive agent counts
View registry & arbitration, view origin, listener/streaming-source derivation (C-VIEW)
Per-phase transform change sets published once to all spatial replicas

areas.name: Environment systems
caps: Global wind field state & queries (via C-ENV)

areas.name: Voxel worlds
caps: Runtime world edits with replication & persistence hand-off

areas.name: Render architecture
caps: Shading path choice (forward+, deferred, visibility buffer)
Simulation→render extraction: change-tracked, parallel, versioned delta streams (CPU cost O(changes))
Multi-view rendering: split-screen, PiP, captures, stereo/multiview and N-view (autostereo/light-field) outputs
Submission strategy per hardware tier (GPU-driven vs CPU-culled batched), by ADR; TBDR suitability
Editor render features: GPU picking, selection outline, editor primitives, preview scenes & thumbnails

areas.name: Hardware interface
caps: Pipeline-state models & caches (PSO, pipeline libraries, shader objects), async creation
GPU fault instrumentation: breadcrumbs, markers, dump generation, device-lost recovery
Binding-model tiers: bindless (default where capable) and bounded bind-group/descriptor-set tier
Implicit-synchronization backends (WebGPU): graph barrier output mapped or elided
Driver version policy: minimum/known-bad drivers, deny-lists, user handling
Null/software GPU device for headless CI (WARP/lavapipe/SwiftShader class)
GPU-generated work primitives (indirect, device-generated commands, work-graph programs, backing memory)
D3D12 backend: validation layers & conformance runs
Vulkan backend: validation layers & conformance runs
Metal backend: validation layers & conformance runs
WebGPU backend: validation layers & conformance runs

areas.name: GPU memory & resources
caps: Residency mechanism & budget reporting (policy in RES.MGMT.arbitration)
Resource lifetime tracking decoupled from frame boundaries

areas.name: Render graph & GPU scheduling
caps: Pass merging & tile-memory use on TBDR GPUs
Scheduling, barriers & memory for GPU-generated work incl. work graphs
General GPU compute for non-render systems
Render-graph access validation against executed commands & sync-validation layers

areas.name: Shader system
caps: Compilation toolchain (DXC, Slang, SPIR-V, Metal shader converter)
PSO coverage validation from play traces
Load-time PSO precaching from loaded asset/material/pass combinations
Permutation & PSO-count budgets with cook-time enforcement
In-shader neural evaluation (cooperative-vector/tensor intrinsics, weight layout, fallbacks)
Shader-side binding abstraction generated per binding tier
Shader-side debug draw for GPU-driven passes

areas.name: Materials
caps: Custom/stylized lighting models across shading paths

areas.name: GPU-driven geometry pipeline
caps: GPU frustum & two-phase HZB occlusion culling
Indirect draws & dispatch (primitives provided by RND.RHI.gpu-work)
CPU-culled batched/instanced submission as a first-class tier path (own budgets and tests)
Runtime-editable dynamic mesh representation & GPU upload
Gaussian-splat / radiance-field rendering, sorting, LOD & compositing

areas.name: Textures & virtual texturing
caps: Streaming-friendly mip & tile layout in cook

areas.name: Global illumination & reflections
caps: Surface / radiance-cache hybrid GI (software + hardware RT)
Neural radiance caching with online training

areas.name: Ray tracing infrastructure
caps: Acceleration structure build, refit, compaction & update scheduling
Inline RT vs RT pipelines & shader tables

areas.name: Path tracing
caps: Reference path tracer as ground-truth oracle (dev-only; compute fallback without HW RT)

areas.name: Reconstruction, resolution & denoising
caps: Temporal & ML upscalers (DLSS, FSR, XeSS, PSSR class)
Foveated rendering implementation (VRS, fragment density maps, multi-res)

areas.name: Post-processing, HDR & color
caps: Post chain (bloom, depth of field, motion blur, lens)
Color management pipeline (working space, display transforms, OCIO)
HDR output (PQ, scRGB, metadata; platform calibration from C-PAL)

areas.name: 2D, vector & UI rendering
caps: UI render backend (batching, clipping, SDF, HDR compositing)

areas.name: GPU platform
caps: GPU feature-tier model & API baselines per hardware tier (C-GPUTIER)
Parallel command recording; render work as tasks (no dedicated render thread unless an API mandates affinity, by ADR)

areas.name: Media playback
caps: A/V sync against the audio clock
Video surfaces for UI, world & cinematics
Video middleware decision (Bink class vs platform decoders)

areas.name: Rendering authoring tools
caps: Material editor tool logic: preview, parameters, instances, live update
VFX editor tool logic: emitter stack, preview, timeline, bounds
Lighting authoring: probe/capture placement, lighting scenarios, density visualization
Tilemap painting, auto-tiling rules, sprite slicing & editing

areas.name: Inference
caps: Inference scheduling within frame budgets incl. online in-frame training
NPU backends via platform ML APIs

areas.name: Physics architecture
caps: Physics engine build vs integrate decision (evidence: benchmark scenes, determinism, rewind, GPU path, license)
State snapshot/restore, partial resimulation, state hashing & collider history
Decoupled/async physics stepping with input marshalling & interpolation
Physics world streaming: per-cell activation, bulk/async insertion, collision-before-render
Middleware/fork integration layer & upstream patch ownership
Physics oracle suite: analytic & reference scenes

areas.name: Characters & vehicles
caps: Controller interaction with dynamic bodies (push, carry, ride, moving platforms)
Controller ground, step, slope & ledge sensing queries

areas.name: Destruction
caps: Runtime fracture & debris management (large-scale runtime fracture per ADR)

areas.name: Physics authoring tools
caps: Collision authoring (primitive fitting, convex decomposition UI)

areas.name: Animation architecture
caps: Animation-side obligations within the canonical simulation schedule; root-motion policy
Animation replication, prediction & server evaluation policy
Animation oracle suite: pose/compression/retarget error metrics

areas.name: Animation runtime
caps: Pose history buffer for rewind/lag compensation
2D skeletal import (Spine class) incl. IK & mesh constraints

areas.name: Skinning & deformation
caps: Instanced crowd deformation: VAT, animation textures, animated impostors

areas.name: IK, procedural & physical animation
caps: Physical animation, active ragdoll & ragdoll blending

areas.name: Cinematics
caps: Gameplay takeover, input blocking, skippable & blended cutscenes

areas.name: Animation authoring tools
caps: Skeleton, skeletal-mesh & clip editor (sockets, notifies, curves, montages, compression preview)
Animation graph & blend-space editing and debugging

areas.name: Audio architecture
caps: Middleware integration decision (own vs Wwise/FMOD class)
Audio clock, output-latency measurement & A/V/input sync contract
Audio oracle suite: bit-exact offline render, loudness, glitch & latency
Offline faster-than-real-time render & null audio device

areas.name: Spatial audio & acoustics
caps: Object-based output (Atmos, Tempest 3D, Windows Sonic class)

areas.name: Audio content runtime
caps: VO playback & ducking for C-DIALOGUE lines
Runtime neural TTS/ASR for gameplay dialogue

areas.name: Audio authoring tools

areas.name: Devices

Eye tracking as an input device (desktop/laptop)
Virtual input device injection for bots & tests

areas.name: Network architecture

Network budgets & scale targets (players, entities, bandwidth)
Compatibility-window policy & handshake (live-ops version skew, crossplay patch skew, rolling server deploys)
Connectivity loss, sign-out & suspend/resume session policy
Netcode oracle suite: deterministic net simulation, prediction/replication correctness metrics
Seamless dynamic server meshing / cross-server entity authority

areas.name: Transport
caps: Browser transports (WebSocket, WebRTC data channels; WebTransport where available)
Anti-amplification handshake, stateless challenges, rate limiting, relay-shielded addressing
Platform networking requirements (IPv6-only/NAT64, network change & migration, connectivity state)

areas.name: Replication
caps: Replays from the replication stream (C-REPLAY producer)
Spectator/broadcast clients with delay & observer relevancy

areas.name: Prediction & latency hiding

Shipping input-stream replays for lockstep games

areas.name: Servers

Server host OS & container specifics (Linux, ARM64 hosts)

areas.name: Network debugging & profiling

Record/replay of full network sessions for debugging

areas.name: Gameplay framework

Player/agent ↔ controlled-entity association as data (control model per game by ADR)
Gameplay execution model: scheduled systems/jobs with declared access; no per-object tick by default
Gameplay view-model exposure for HUD & menus
Objective/quest state extension point with save & replication hooks

areas.name: Gameplay systems toolkit

Spawning (batched, deferred structural changes); pooling only where measured
Gameplay-tag message channels built on C-ID events
Predicted abilities & effects (prediction keys, rollback of effects)
Surface-type impact effects routing (audio, VFX, decals, haptics)
Trigger & gameplay volumes, gameplay markers, level-scoped logic wiring
Hit/hurtbox authoring, frame data & hit resolution

areas.name: Scripting

areas.name: Character movement

Networked predicted/reconciled movement & resimulatable move API

areas.name: Gameplay data

areas.name: Narrative & dialogue

Narrative fact & flag store with save/replication participation

areas.name: Gameplay authoring tools
caps: Behavior-tree, state-tree & environment-query editors and testing

Semantic accessibility tree for game UI
UI logic hosting via reflection-invoked handlers (script/visual script)

areas.name: Text & fonts

areas.name: Accessibility

Agent/automation control & introspection protocol for editor and runtime

areas.name: Editor UI framework

Editor toolkit basis: shared with or separate from game UI (ADR)

areas.name: World editor

Level-design utilities: measure, filters, bulk replace, layer visibility

areas.name: Collaboration & version control

areas.name: Visual debugging

Evaluation harness for generative & ML-assisted tools

areas.name: Build system

Build distribution to QA, playtesters, betas & devkits
Zero-infrastructure local workflow (local caches, single-machine CI)
Title release-branch stabilization, content lock & hotfix streams
LTS backport/hotfix streams incl. security backports

Install-on-demand & streaming install (AAB/Play Asset Delivery, iOS background assets)
API runtime redistribution (Agility SDK, DXC runtime)
End-of-service: offline fallback, community server release, data export

Cross-skill integration suites & per-configuration build/boot/test matrix

Fault injection (IO errors, OOM, device lost)

Rating & platform disclosure for runtime-generated content
